description: The files that a search role runs, relative to the repository root. The search roles are deployed by hand (goodwatch-search/deploy.sh), so they can run an older commit than the page instances. The smoke check compares the two commits over these paths and warns when a role is behind and one of them differs. A change anywhere else needs no deploy of the roles. The list is the code of the two search paths and its direct neighbors, not everything that the image holds: keep it in step with the imports of routes/api.combined-search.ts and routes/api.command-palette.ts.

guards.goodwatch-webapp/app/server/search-ranki: The query encoder, the search index, and the ranking.
guards.goodwatch-webapp/app/server/search.serve: The TMDB title search that the command palette answers from while the index loads.
guards.goodwatch-webapp/app/server/lifecycle.se: Readiness and the drain on SIGTERM, which the proxy's health check and deploy.sh rely on.
guards.goodwatch-webapp/app/ui/search/search-mo: The shape of the search response, which the browser's script from a page instance reads.
guards.goodwatch-webapp/vite.config.js: It names the worker files of the encoder and the index for the server bundle.
